operational_constraints.determinism: Strictly deterministic given identical case context

channel_1_terminal_mule_district.description: All clusters located within the terminal beneficiary/mule revenue district
channel_1_terminal_mule_district.rationale: High empirical pull towards terminal mule operating zone

channel_2_fraud_type_historical_affinity.description: Historical top 4 clusters favored by this specific fraud family computed strictly from prior history
channel_2_fraud_type_historical_affinity.rationale: Captures established syndicate cash-out corridor preferences

channel_3_local_origin_proximity.description: Geographically closest clusters within the victim's origin revenue district
channel_3_local_origin_proximity.allocation_quota: Top 4 clusters closest to victim coordinates
channel_3_local_origin_proximity.rationale: Ensures coverage for immediate local cash-out complaints

channel_4_high_mobility_commercial_hubs.description: Top commercial / transit / ATM hubs across Delhi (e.g. Connaught Place, Nehru Place, Laxmi Nagar, Saket)
channel_4_high_mobility_commercial_hubs.rationale: Captures cross-district evasion where fraudsters travel to dense commercial cash-out zones

channel_5_adjacent_corridors.description: Clusters in revenue districts directly adjacent to either terminal mule or victim origin districts
channel_5_adjacent_corridors.allocation_quota: Top 6 clusters sorted by spatial proximity to origin
channel_5_adjacent_corridors.rationale: Captures suburban border crossings and transit corridor movement

channel_6_global_fallback.allocation_quota: Fills remaining slots up to exactly 25 candidates

deduplication_and_ordering.policy: Deterministic priority ordering: Channel 1 -> Channel 2 -> Channel 3 -> Channel 4 -> Channel 5 -> Channel 6
deduplication_and_ordering.deduplication: Set-based insertion preserving first seen priority

subgroup_coverage_checks.district_subgroup_collapse: NO — all 11 revenue districts have minimum 71% candidate recall
subgroup_coverage_checks.fraud_subgroup_collapse: NO — all 9 fraud types have minimum 73% candidate recall
